title: Citation Grounding for RAG: Reduce Hallucinations in Python
description:
Citation grounding: force source-only answers with inline citations to eliminate LLM hallucinations.  
Build a simple, auditable Python pattern that creates sentence-level chunks, an inverted index, and a coverage audit so answers only quote verifiable sources.  
Demo uses Python with an in-memory inverted index (scales to ANN or disk-backed indexes) and stable chunk IDs for traceable citations.  
Subscribe for practical AI engineering tutorials from Professor Py and hands-on LLM grounding techniques.
